steps.title: Ingest and filing appear on the organisation audit ledger surface
steps.action: GET /api/audit-trail/ledger?limit=200 (the read model behind /concept2cure/audit-trail)
steps.expected: The ledger window lists the ingest and the filing of this document, each carrying record/previous hashes, and the server's chain verdict says the chain verifies (meta.chain.ok = true)
steps.observed: ledger window 200 (baseline 200); 3 chained entr(ies) for the document: Vault Document File, Vault Document Download, Vault Document Ingest; server chain verdict ok=true over 265 row(s)
steps.note: The ledger surface reads audit_logs merged with audit_events (server/routes/audit-trail-ledger.routes.ts) — the chained store vault ingest and filing write through server/services/auditService.ts writeChainedAuditRow. The read is a newest-first WINDOW (limit), so a ledger already longer than the window cannot "grow"; the observable claim is that this document's events are in it, hash-chained, and that the server's own verdict (meta.chain) says the chain verifies. A verdict that is present but ok=false is a failure: v0.2 asserted only presence, and the 2026-09-21 record passed this step over "server chain verdict ok=false over 33 row(s)". If this step fails, the surface a user is told to inspect does not show the writes the launch apps make.

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: a version is sent for review only on a review route; the uploader may not review it; the named reviewer signs the review over its bytes; the reviewer may not approve it
steps.action: POST /api/regulatory/documents naming the OQ-VAULT-11 version, twice; POST …/:id/advance {to:"in_review"} with no route; POST …/:id/advance {to:"in_review", reason, route} naming the run identity (the uploader) as reviewer, then OQ_SIGNER as reviewer and as approver; GET …/:id; the same naming OQ_SIGNER as reviewer and OQ_APPROVER as approver; as the run identity POST …/:id/sign {meaning:"reviewed", reason}; as OQ_SIGNER POST …/:id/sign {meaning:"reviewed", reason, password, mfaToken?}; as OQ_SIGNER POST …/:id/sign {meaning:"approved", …} and POST …/:id/advance {to:"approved", …}; GET …/documents/:id/versions
steps.expected: One lifecycle record (the second start returns it, created:false). The send without a route 409 REVIEW_ROUTE_REQUIRED. The route naming the uploader 409 MEMBER_IS_AUTHOR; the route naming the reviewer as approver too 409 MEMBER_ALREADY_NAMED; the record still in authoring. The route naming OQ_SIGNER and OQ_APPROVER 200, in_review, with its routeId. The uploader's review 403 ROUTE_NOT_NAMED; the signer's review 200 with boundContentHash equal to the version's SHA-256, completing the review; the signer's approval by signing 403 ROUTE_NOT_NAMED and by advancing 409 ROUTE_APPROVAL_BY_SIGN; the versions list shows the version In review with the review's printed name, and the route: the reviewer signed, the approver's step open. Without OQ_SIGNER_* or OQ_APPROVER_* (a third identity, the route's approver) the step is recorded "not executed — credential not supplied".
steps.observed: record bd2c9875-a741-4536-a8b4-4ba370f0c54e: unrouted send refused (REVIEW_ROUTE_REQUIRED); uploader and reviewer-as-approver not admitted to the route; route 77848cd5-4ed5-4ee4-91de-1b9f1b9385ca sent; uploader's review refused; reviewed by OQ Signer, bound to 3a136831003c…; reviewer's approval refused by sign and by advance; approver OQ Approver's step open
steps.note: Revised in OQ-002 v0.15 (RR1b, docs/design/REVIEW_ROUTING_2026-10-23.md §2.6, §2.13): a Vault version enters review only on a route naming its reviewers and one approver. Separation of duties is asserted where the route enforces it first (the validator refuses to name the uploader, or the reviewer as approver) and again at signing (a person the route does not name in that role signs nothing). The v0.6 code SELF_APPROVAL belongs to the unrouted path, which no handler reaches for a Vault version since RR1b.

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: the route's approver approves v1, then v2, by signing on the route; approving v2 supersedes v1; the approved version's details cannot be edited
steps.action: Ingest a new document (v1.0); send it for review on a route naming OQ_SIGNER as reviewer and OQ_APPROVER as approver; OQ_SIGNER signs the review; OQ_APPROVER signs the approval (POST …/:id/sign {meaning:"approved", reason, password, mfaToken?}). Check in v2.0 and repeat. GET …/documents/:v2/versions. POST …/documents/:v2/details {documentTitle, reason}
steps.expected: Each send 200 in_review. Each review 200, completing the review. Each approval 200 approvalComplete:true, stage approved, bound to that version's SHA-256: the server approves on the last required signature. v2's approval answers superseded:[v1's record]; the versions list shows v2.0 Approved (the approver's printed name), its route complete, and v1.0 Superseded; the edit 409 APPROVED_VERSION_IMMUTABLE. Without OQ_APPROVER_EMAIL / OQ_APPROVER_PASSWORD (a third identity) the step is recorded "not executed — credential not supplied".
steps.observed: v1.0 approved on route ecdf7223-2579-4213-91a9-f1f361a7450b, then superseded by v2.0 (approved on route 4ecd6bf5-4665-4f8f-a791-6428408ddd3f by OQ Approver, route complete); the approved version's edit refused
steps.note: Revised in OQ-002 v0.15 (RR1b): v0.6 approved through POST …/:id/advance {to:"approved"}, which a routed record refuses (ROUTE_APPROVAL_BY_SIGN, asserted in OQ-VAULT-13). The identities are the ones OQ-VAULT-13 resolved.

Read the annotations and the text file's history.

The list shows the passage resolved with its reply and the comment retracted; the history carries "Extracted text read…", "Change request posted on a passage…", "Reply to…", "Annotation resolved…" and "Annotation retracted…", and says nothing is cut.
steps.observed: page and passage annotations posted; the passage thread resolved; a comment retracted; 5 acts in the history
